Usage: rhythm-sightread explain <signal-id> | <report.json> <n|fingerprint>

With a signal ID, prints what the signal means, why it matters, how to review
it, its usual false alarms and the incidents it is built on. It needs no
network. With a saved JSON report and a finding's number (as the report counts
them, from 1) or fingerprint, prints that finding, its evidence and the diff
hunk with 6 lines of context, read from the archives the review cached. A review
of a local file (--from-file, --to-file) or one whose archives are no longer
cached shows the hunk the report saved.

Flags:
  --json   print the kind explain JSON document

Examples:
  rhythm-sightread explain remote-fetch-exec
  rhythm-sightread explain review.json 3
  rhythm-sightread explain review.json 9f2c41aa07d3b6e1
